dc:title: List of Greenlandic and Faroese Governments

tableSchema.notes: Table with a list of all governments in Greenland (Naalakkersuisut) and the Faroe Islands (Landsstýri) for the time frame covered by the nordatlantisk-ft dataset (starting 2004).

columns.name: cabinet
columns.dc:title: Cabinet Name
columns.description: ID for the cabinet, usually named af the head of government

columns.name: wikidata_ID
columns.dc:title: Cabinet Wikidata ID
columns.description: Wikidata Identifier for the entity representing each cabinet

columns.name: location
columns.dc:title: Location
columns.description: Identifier whether this cabinet is from Greenland or the Faroe Islands.

columns.dc:title: Start Date
columns.description: Date the coalition took office
